name: US jobless claims
summary: US jobless claims at their 52-week low
state: Initial US jobless claims were 194,000 in the week to 24 Oct, taking the four-week average to about 197,000, level with its 52-week low and far from the 15% Watch line. Layoffs show no sign of rising despite higher energy costs.
for_you: The US jobs market remains tight, with no wave of layoffs under way.
why: Weekly claims are the earliest hard data on US layoffs; a sustained rise usually comes before the unemployment rate turns.
drivers: Layoffs, hiring freezes, federal job cuts, storms, strikes and seasonal quirks.

rubric.normal: The 4-week average of initial claims is less than 15% above its 52-week low.
